description: Test suite for the 'litellm' library, focusing on testing the WatsonX LLM interface, including request payloads, token handling, model-specific behavior, and prompt transformations. Contains multiple fixtures and test cases using pytest, mocks, and patching to verify request contents and side-effects.

classes.name: HTTPHandler
classes.description: Custom HTTP handler class used in tests for mocking HTTP interactions.

methods.description: Fixture function to generate a wrapped call to 'completion' with mocked HTTP responses for chat models.

methods.description: Test that deployment models do not include 'model_id' in payload.

methods.name: test_watsonx_regular_model_includes_model_id( monkeypatch, watsonx_chat_completion_call )
methods.description: Test that regular models include 'model_id' in payload.

methods.name: watsonx_completion_call()
methods.description: Fixture function to generate a wrapped call to 'litellm.text_completion', with mocking for token fetch and request.

methods.name: test_watsonx_completion_deployment_model_id_not_in_payload( monkeypatch, watsonx_completion_call )
methods.description: Test for the absence of 'model_id' in completion request payload for deployment models.

methods.name: test_watsonx_completion_regular_model_includes_model_id( monkeypatch, watsonx_completion_call )
methods.description: Test that regular models include 'model_id' in completion request payload.

methods.name: test_watsonx_gpt_oss_prompt_transformation(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test that messages are correctly transformed using a HuggingFace template instead of simple concatenation for gpt-oss-120b model.

methods.name: test_watsonx_gpt_oss_uses_async_http_handler()
methods.description: Verify that async HTTP client is used when fetching HuggingFace templates.

methods.name: test_watsonx_chat_completion_with_reasoning_effort(monkeypatch)
methods.description: Test that 'reasoning_effort' parameter is correctly included in the request payload.

methods.name: test_watsonx_zen_api_key_from_client(monkeypatch, watsonx_chat_completion_call)
methods.description: Verify that zen_api_key passed from client code is used for authorization.

methods.name: test_watsonx_zen_api_key_from_env(monkeypatch, watsonx_chat_completion_call)
methods.description: Verify that zen_api_key read from environment variable is used for authorization.
